OUR MENTORING PHILOSOPHY

"These teenagers do not need rescuing.
They need a room with high ceilings."

The way we mentor: listen first — twice as long as feels reasonable — then ask one hard question. Every volunteer who works with a young person is safeguarding-screened before their first session.

Ready? Pick your door.

NGG runs all year — clubs, mentoring, events, media. The Summer School runs only in the summer, with its own courses. The one form takes either, or both.
